'''Deers''' was an [[Imperial Army/Legends|Imperial Army]] [[Colonel/Legends|colonel]] assigned to the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Havoc (Imperial-class)|''Havoc'']]. Deers commanded ground troops tasked with tracking down [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] survivors of the siege of [[Edan Base]] on [[Edan II/Legends|Edan II]].
